name: megascenes-voiceover
description: Turn a script into a natural voice-over audio file for videos, podcasts, ads and presentations.

interface.longDescription:
Paste a script and get it read aloud as an audio file, with a voice that fits: warm, energetic, calm or authoritative, in many languages.

ChatGPT tells you what the run needs for that length of text and creates the voice-over in your MegaScenes account when you ask. The audio plays in the chat and stays in your library.

For video narration, podcast intros, ads and e-learning.

Limitations: speech from the text you give; it does not clone a voice or edit audio you attach in the chat. Making a file needs a signed-in MegaScenes account and runs in it; nothing is made until you confirm. Not for sexual or adult content or for real people's likeness. Files are made by generative models and saved in your MegaScenes library.
capabilities: Read a script aloud as an audio file
Return the audio in the chat
defaultPrompt: Read this intro in a warm voice: Welcome back to the Morning Brief.
A 20-second radio ad script for a bike shop, read with energy
Which voices can read a script in Spanish?

positive.prompt: Read this in a warm voice: Welcome back to the Morning Brief, your five-minute start to the day. Tell me what it needs, but don't create it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: What a voice-over of that script needs. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: Narrate this: Our story began in a small garage in 1998, with two friends and one idea. Don't create it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: What a voice-over of that script needs. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: Which voice models can I use here?
positive.expected_behavior: The voice models with their settings. Nothing is created.

positive.description: Make it after an explicit request
positive.prompt: Read this in a calm voice: Thank you for calling. Your appointment is confirmed for Monday at ten. Create it now.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT says what the run needs and, once the person confirms, one job starts in the signed-in MegaScenes account; the status tool reports progress and, when it succeeds, returns the file link, which the result view shows.

positive.prompt: Which MegaScenes account am I signed in with?
positive.expected_behavior: The email and plan of the signed-in account. Nothing is created.

negative.prompt: Press 200 vinyl records of my voice-over and ship them to my store.
Send my voice-over to my producer by email at sam@example.com.
What time is it in Tokyo right now?

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments. Making a file runs in the user's existing MegaScenes account; no purchase happens in the conversation.

publication.release_notes: Name only: the brand suffix is gone from the plugin name. No change to the tools, the server or the listing text.
